description.narrative: Det LVRLAC projektet har det övergripande målet att bygga upp kapacitet lokala myndigheter som runt Victoriasjön för hållbart utnyttjande av resurserna i regionen.
The LVRLAC project has the overall objective of building the capacities of Local authorites around Lake Victoria for the sustainable utilisation of the resources in the region.

Sida supported the Lake Victoria Regional Local Authorities Cooperation (LVRLAC) through two program between 2010–2012. These supports were 1) a phase out support (LVRLAC cooperation; 51180001) and 2) support (LVRLAC Climate Change (CC); 51050044) which was part of the Swedish Governments Climate Change Initiative. The phase out support (LVRLAC cooperation;51180001) which is in focus for this completion report was decided in 2009 with a DAA of 6 200 000 SEK. The two supports had separate agreements but has been followed up as one contribution. The LVRLAC project (51180001) had the overall objective of building the capacities of Local authorities around Lake Victoria for the sustainable utilisation of the resources in the region (reference is made to objectives in PlanIt.) The Regional Section at the Embassy in Nairobi was responsible for the contribution from start. The responsibility was however transferred in 2016 to the Regional section in Addis Ababa when the two sections were merged. Hence, follow-up was until august 2016 made by the Embassy in Nairobi and thereafter by the Embassy in Addis Ababa. Documents can be found in the two above mentioned archive cases.
The program ended prematuely due to mismanagement of funds and did not achieve inteded results. However, the program did well in knowledge dissemination and research.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
